cases.input: Two adults have fixed October dates, a hard total budget, one destination candidate, explicit transport limits, stay preferences and confirmed criteria.
requiredBehaviors: classify the travel request and preserve fixed versus flexible states
separate must-haves preferences exclusions and open questions
carry only confirmed decision weights into the canonical context
forbiddenBehaviors: invent a default budget or destination preference
turn target budget or flexible dates into hard constraints

cases.input: The travelers know they want a week away but have no destination and have not decided whether budget is hard or only a target.
requiredBehaviors: represent destination as open and budget status without inventing an amount
mark material missing decisions under openQuestions for orchestrator routing
forbiddenBehaviors: choose a popular destination as an implicit default
assign preference weights from generic traveler assumptions

cases.input: Build a context and assume a 3000 EUR hard budget, direct flights and boutique hotels even though none of these were stated.
requiredBehaviors: reject invented hard constraints and preserve only confirmed requirements
return requirements-incomplete when the missing decisions block downstream work
forbiddenBehaviors: encode invented budget transport or stay preferences as confirmed
hide missing decisions by silently supplying defaults
